responsibility: Implements the core GCC backend logic for the Vitesse IQ2000 target beyond the declarative .md patterns. This file owns target hook implementations and helper routines for calling convention setup, argument passing and varargs, frame-size computation and prologue/epilogue generation, return handling, address legitimacy and section selection, builtin initialization/expansion, cost modeling, register/mode legality, trampoline emission, delay-slot scheduling support, and final instruction output decisions, translating generic GCC RTL and tree-level target hooks into IQ2000-specific code-generation behavior.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable C++ implementation file for the IQ2000 port: it defines the target hooks and helper functions declared or referenced by the rest of the port, such as frame computation, address legitimization, builtin expansion, costs, and trampoline/prologue logic. Unlike iq2000.h, it does not define the machine-description macros; unlike iq2000.md, it does not declare RTL instruction patterns and delay-slot automata; unlike iq2000.opt, it does not define command-line options.
